features.title: Canonical versioned page document
features.outcome: The seller's saved page uses one durable contract across Studio, preview and public rendering.

acceptance.outcome: Acknowledged changes survive a service restart.
Another seller cannot read or modify the document.
Two-tab edits surface conflicts without silently losing acknowledged changes.

metrics.name: acknowledged_write_loss
metrics.definition: Acknowledged revisions missing after restart / acknowledged revisions in the synthetic test batch.

features.title: Minimal seller Studio
features.outcome: A seller can choose a template, edit essential content and understand save state.

acceptance.outcome: Seller edits and ordering match the preview at the saved revision.
Offline or failed saves retain recoverable changes and never show a false Saved state.

metrics.name: first_page_completion
metrics.definition: Unassisted saved first pages / observed eligible first-time sellers within the pilot session.
metrics.target: Measure baseline before setting improvement target

features.title: Publish, share and unpublish
features.outcome: An anonymous buyer can open the intended published revision, while drafts stay private.

acceptance.outcome: Public content matches the approved revision; later draft edits do not leak.
Retrying a publish does not create duplicate logical publications.
Unpublished pages stop serving content within the documented cache bound.

metrics.name: publish_propagation
metrics.definition: Elapsed seconds from acknowledged publication to anonymous visibility of the matching revision; report median and p95 for a declared test workload.
